data_problems: ROUTINE SETUP BUG, worked around here but it needs the owner's fix: the step-0 line `python3 -c "import fitz" || pip install --quiet pymupdf` does not work on this VM. `pip` resolves to Python 3.13 (/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages) while `python3` is 3.11, so the install reports success and `import fitz` still fails. Measured consequence BEFORE the workaround: minsteel.py died with a ModuleNotFoundError traceback, and india_spot.py reported BOTH fuel and moil as "FAILED (No module named 'fitz')" - moil was a false failure. Any previous run on a VM with this layout silently lost the PDF-backed sources.

NSE RETURNS A BROKEN DOCUMENT LINK AND THE QUEUE CARRIES IT THROUGH, so a filing looked unreadable when it was not. For Morepen's 19-Oct 'Integrated Filing- Governance', updates_queue.json gives pdf = 'https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/null'.
